cohort: The study included all singleton intrauterine fetal death (IUFD) cases between 22 and 28 gestational weeks in the Stockholm region, Sweden, from 2008 to 2015.
finding: IUFD cases induced with lower prostaglandin doses (equivalent to misoprostol <=200 mg within 6 hours) had significantly longer time to fetal expulsion and were almost twice as likely to have an induction lasting over 12 hours compared to higher doses.
